# stripe_metronome_package (Resource)

Metronome package. Prefer the typed package attribute, generated from CreatePackagePayload in the pinned OpenAPI spec. request and request_json remain for compatibility and API escape hatches. Destroy archives the package.

### Nested Schema for `package.commits`

Required:

- `access_schedule` (Attributes) Required: Schedule for distributing the commit to the customer. For "POSTPAID" commits only one schedule item is allowed and amount must match invoice_schedule total. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--package--commits--access_schedule))
- `product_id` (String)
- `type` (String)

Optional:

- `applicable_product_ids` (List of String) Which products the commit applies to. If applicable_product_ids, applicable_product_tags or specifiers are not provided, the commit applies to all products.
- `applicable_product_tags` (List of String) Which tags the commit applies to. If applicable_product_ids, applicable_product_tags or specifiers are not provided, the commit applies to all products.
- `custom_fields` (Map of String)
- `description` (String) Used only in UI/API. It is not exposed to end customers.
- `invoice_schedule` (Attributes) Required for "POSTPAID" commits: the true up invoice will be generated at this time and only one schedule item is allowed; the total must match access_schedule amount. Optional for "PREPAID" commits: if not provided, this will be a "complimentary" commit with no invoice. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--package--commits--invoice_schedule))
- `name` (String) displayed on invoices
- `priority` (Number) If multiple commits are applicable, the one with the lower priority will apply first.
- `rate_type` (String)
- `rollover_fraction` (Number) Fraction of unused segments that will be rolled over. Must be between 0 and 1.
- `specifiers` (Attributes List) List of filters that determine what kind of customer usage draws down a commit or credit. A customer's usage needs to meet the condition of at least one of the specifiers to contribute to a commit's or credit's drawdown. This field cannot be used together with `applicable_product_ids` or `applicable_product_tags`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--package--commits--specifiers))
- `temporary_id` (String) A temporary ID for the commit that can be used to reference the commit for commit specific overrides.

### Nested Schema for `package.prepaid_balance_threshold_configuration`

Required:

Optional:

<a id="nestedatt--package--prepaid_balance_threshold_configuration--commit"></a>
### Nested Schema for `package.prepaid_balance_threshold_configuration.commit`

Required:

- `product_id` (String) The commit product that will be used to generate the line item for commit payment.

Optional:

- `applicable_product_ids` (List of String) Which products the threshold commit applies to. If applicable_product_ids, applicable_product_tags or specifiers are not provided, the commit applies to all products.
- `applicable_product_tags` (List of String) Which tags the threshold commit applies to. If applicable_product_ids, applicable_product_tags or specifiers are not provided, the commit applies to all products.
- `description` (String)
- `duration` (Attributes) The length of time the created commit will be valid, starting from the end of the invoice's service period. If not provided, defaults to one year. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--package--prepaid_balance_threshold_configuration--commit--duration))
- `name` (String) Specify the name of the line item for the threshold charge. If left blank, it will default to the commit product name.
- `priority` (Number) The priority of the commit, used to determine drawdown order. Lower priority commits are consumed first. Defaults to 100 if not specified.
- `rate_type` (String) Whether the created commits will be charged at commit rate or list rate.
- `rollover_fraction` (Number) Fraction of the created commit's unused balance that will roll over. Must be between 0 and 1.
- `specifiers` (Attributes List) List of filters that determine what kind of customer usage draws down a commit or credit. A customer's usage needs to meet the condition of at least one of the specifiers to contribute to a commit's or credit's drawdown. This field cannot be used together with `applicable_product_ids` or `applicable_product_tags`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--package--prepaid_balance_threshold_configuration--commit--specifiers))

<a id="nestedatt--package--prepaid_balance_threshold_configuration--payment_gate_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `package.prepaid_balance_threshold_configuration.payment_gate_config`

Required:

- `payment_gate_type` (String) Gate access to the commit balance based on successful collection of payment. Select STRIPE for Metronome to facilitate payment via Stripe. Select EXTERNAL to facilitate payment using your own payment integration. Select NONE if you do not wish to payment gate the commit balance.

Optional:

- `precalculated_tax_config` (Attributes) Only applicable if using PRECALCULATED as your tax type. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--package--prepaid_balance_threshold_configuration--payment_gate_config--precalculated_tax_config))
- `stripe_config` (Attributes) Only applicable if using STRIPE as your payment gate type. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--package--prepaid_balance_threshold_configuration--payment_gate_config--stripe_config))
- `tax_type` (String) Stripe tax is only supported for Stripe payment gateway. Select NONE if you do not wish Metronome to calculate tax on your behalf. Leaving this field blank will default to NONE.

<a id="nestedatt--package--prepaid_balance_threshold_configuration--payment_gate_config--precalculated_tax_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `package.prepaid_balance_threshold_configuration.payment_gate_config.precalculated_tax_config`

Required:

- `tax_amount` (Number) Amount of tax to be applied. This should be in the same currency and denomination  as the commit's invoice schedule

Optional:

- `tax_name` (String) Name of the tax to be applied. This may be used in an invoice line item description.

Optional:

- `invoice_metadata` (Map of String) Metadata to be added to the Stripe invoice. Only applicable if using INVOICE as your payment type.

<a id="nestedatt--package--recurring_commits"></a>
### Nested Schema for `package.recurring_commits`

Required:

- `access_amount` (Attributes) The amount of commit to grant. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--package--recurring_commits--access_amount))
- `commit_duration` (Attributes) Defines the length of the access schedule for each created commit/credit. The value represents the number of units. Unit defaults to "PERIODS", where the length of a period is determined by the recurrence_frequency. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--package--recurring_commits--commit_duration))
- `priority` (Number) Will be passed down to the individual commits
- `product_id` (String)
- `starting_at_offset` (Attributes) Offset relative to the contract start date that determines the start time for the first commit (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--package--recurring_commits--starting_at_offset))

Optional:

- `applicable_product_ids` (List of String) Will be passed down to the individual commits
- `applicable_product_tags` (List of String) Will be passed down to the individual commits
- `description` (String) Will be passed down to the individual commits
- `duration` (Attributes) Offset relative to the recurring credit start that determines when the contract will stop creating recurring commits. optional (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--package--recurring_commits--duration))
- `invoice_amount` (Attributes) The amount the customer should be billed for the commit. Not required. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--package--recurring_commits--invoice_amount))
- `name` (String) displayed on invoices. will be passed through to the individual commits
- `proration` (String) Determines whether the first and last commit will be prorated.  If not provided, the default is FIRST_AND_LAST (i.e. prorate both the first and last commits).
- `proration_rounding` (Attributes) Optional rounding configuration for prorated recurring commit amounts. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--package--recurring_commits--proration_rounding))
- `rate_type` (String) Whether the created commits will use the commit rate or list rate
- `recurrence_frequency` (String) The frequency at which the recurring commits will be created. If not provided: - The commits will be created on the usage invoice frequency. If provided: - The period defined in the duration will correspond to this frequency. - Commits will be created aligned with the recurring commit's starting_at rather than the usage invoice dates. - Daily recurring commits have a limit of one per contract, and are unable to be created with seat-based subscriptions
- `rollover_fraction` (Number) Will be passed down to the individual commits. This controls how much of an individual unexpired commit will roll over upon contract transition. Must be between 0 and 1.
- `specifiers` (Attributes List) List of filters that determine what kind of customer usage draws down a commit or credit. A customer's usage needs to meet the condition of at least one of the specifiers to contribute to a commit's or credit's drawdown. This field cannot be used together with `applicable_product_ids` or `applicable_product_tags`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--package--recurring_commits--specifiers))
- `subscription_config` (Attributes) Attach a subscription to the recurring commit/credit. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--package--recurring_commits--subscription_config))
- `temporary_id` (String) A temporary ID that can be used to reference the recurring commit for commit specific overrides.

<a id="nestedatt--package--recurring_commits--proration_rounding--access"></a>
### Nested Schema for `package.recurring_commits.proration_rounding.access`

Required:

- `rounding_method` (String)


<a id="nestedatt--package--recurring_commits--proration_rounding--invoice"></a>

- `presentation_group_values` (Map of String) If provided, the specifier will apply to product usage with these set of presentation group values.
- `pricing_group_values` (Map of String) If provided, the specifier will apply to product usage with these set of pricing group values.
- `product_id` (String) If provided, the specifier will only apply to the product with the specified ID.

<a id="nestedatt--package--recurring_credits"></a>
### Nested Schema for `package.recurring_credits`

Required:

- `access_amount` (Attributes) The amount of commit to grant. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--package--recurring_credits--access_amount))
- `commit_duration` (Attributes) Defines the length of the access schedule for each created commit/credit. The value represents the number of units. Unit defaults to "PERIODS", where the length of a period is determined by the recurrence_frequency. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--package--recurring_credits--commit_duration))
- `priority` (Number) Will be passed down to the individual commits
- `product_id` (String)
- `starting_at_offset` (Attributes) Offset relative to the contract start date that determines the start time for the first commit (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--package--recurring_credits--starting_at_offset))

Optional:

- `applicable_product_ids` (List of String) Will be passed down to the individual commits
- `applicable_product_tags` (List of String) Will be passed down to the individual commits
- `description` (String) Will be passed down to the individual commits
- `duration` (Attributes) Offset relative to the recurring credit start that determines when the contract will stop creating recurring commits. optional (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--package--recurring_credits--duration))
- `name` (String) displayed on invoices. will be passed through to the individual commits
- `proration` (String) Determines whether the first and last commit will be prorated.  If not provided, the default is FIRST_AND_LAST (i.e. prorate both the first and last commits).
- `proration_rounding` (Attributes) Optional rounding configuration for prorated recurring credit amounts. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--package--recurring_credits--proration_rounding))
- `rate_type` (String) Whether the created commits will use the commit rate or list rate
- `recurrence_frequency` (String) The frequency at which the recurring commits will be created. If not provided: - The commits will be created on the usage invoice frequency. If provided: - The period defined in the duration will correspond to this frequency. - Commits will be created aligned with the recurring commit's starting_at rather than the usage invoice dates. - Daily recurring commits have a limit of one per contract, and are unable to be created with seat-based subscriptions
- `rollover_fraction` (Number) Will be passed down to the individual commits. This controls how much of an individual unexpired commit will roll over upon contract transition. Must be between 0 and 1.
- `specifiers` (Attributes List) List of filters that determine what kind of customer usage draws down a commit or credit. A customer's usage needs to meet the condition of at least one of the specifiers to contribute to a commit's or credit's drawdown. This field cannot be used together with `applicable_product_ids` or `applicable_product_tags`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--package--recurring_credits--specifiers))
- `subscription_config` (Attributes) Attach a subscription to the recurring commit/credit. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--package--recurring_credits--subscription_config))
- `temporary_id` (String) A temporary ID that can be used to reference the recurring commit for commit specific overrides.

### Nested Schema for `package.recurring_credits.access_amount`

- `credit_type_id` (String) Defaults to USD (cents) if not passed
- `quantity` (Number) This field is required unless a subscription is attached via `subscription_config`.

<a id="nestedatt--package--spend_threshold_configuration"></a>
### Nested Schema for `package.spend_threshold_configuration`

Required:

- `commit` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--package--spend_threshold_configuration--commit))
- `is_enabled` (Boolean) When set to false, the contract will not be evaluated against the threshold_amount. Toggling to true will result an immediate evaluation, regardless of prior state.
- `payment_gate_config` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--package--spend_threshold_configuration--payment_gate_config))
- `threshold_amount` (Number) Specify the threshold amount for the contract. Each time the contract's usage hits this amount, a threshold charge will be initiated.

Optional:

- `discount_configuration` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--package--spend_threshold_configuration--discount_configuration))

<a id="nestedatt--package--spend_threshold_configuration--commit"></a>
### Nested Schema for `package.spend_threshold_configuration.commit`

Required:

- `product_id` (String) The commit product that will be used to generate the line item for commit payment.

Optional:

- `description` (String)
- `name` (String) Specify the name of the line item for the threshold charge. If left blank, it will default to the commit product name.
- `priority` (Number) The priority of the commit, used to determine drawdown order. Lower priority commits are consumed first. Defaults to 100 if not specified.


<a id="nestedatt--package--spend_threshold_configuration--payment_gate_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `package.spend_threshold_configuration.payment_gate_config`

Required:

- `payment_gate_type` (String) Gate access to the commit balance based on successful collection of payment. Select STRIPE for Metronome to facilitate payment via Stripe. Select EXTERNAL to facilitate payment using your own payment integration. Select NONE if you do not wish to payment gate the commit balance.

Optional:

- `precalculated_tax_config` (Attributes) Only applicable if using PRECALCULATED as your tax type. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--package--spend_threshold_configuration--payment_gate_config--precalculated_tax_config))
- `stripe_config` (Attributes) Only applicable if using STRIPE as your payment gate type. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--package--spend_threshold_configuration--payment_gate_config--stripe_config))
- `tax_type` (String) Stripe tax is only supported for Stripe payment gateway. Select NONE if you do not wish Metronome to calculate tax on your behalf. Leaving this field blank will default to NONE.

<a id="nestedatt--package--spend_threshold_configuration--payment_gate_config--precalculated_tax_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `package.spend_threshold_configuration.payment_gate_config.precalculated_tax_config`

Required:

- `tax_amount` (Number) Amount of tax to be applied. This should be in the same currency and denomination  as the commit's invoice schedule

Optional:

- `tax_name` (String) Name of the tax to be applied. This may be used in an invoice line item description.


<a id="nestedatt--package--spend_threshold_configuration--payment_gate_config--stripe_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `package.spend_threshold_configuration.payment_gate_config.stripe_config`

Required:

- `payment_type` (String) If left blank, will default to INVOICE

Optional:

- `invoice_metadata` (Map of String) Metadata to be added to the Stripe invoice. Only applicable if using INVOICE as your payment type.



<a id="nestedatt--package--spend_threshold_configuration--discount_configuration"></a>
### Nested Schema for `package.spend_threshold_configuration.discount_configuration`

Required:

- `payment_fraction` (Number) The fraction of the original amount that the customer pays after applying the discount. For example, 0.85 means the customer pays 85% of the original amount (a 15% discount).

Optional:

- `cap` (Attributes) If provided, the discount stops applying once the spend tracker has accumulated this much spend in the billing period. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--package--spend_threshold_configuration--discount_configuration--cap))

<a id="nestedatt--package--spend_threshold_configuration--discount_configuration--cap"></a>
### Nested Schema for `package.spend_threshold_configuration.discount_configuration.cap`

Required:

- `amount` (Number) Accumulated spend ceiling above which the discount stops applying.
- `spend_tracker_alias` (String) Alias of the spend tracker this cap is measured against.




<a id="nestedatt--package--spend_trackers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `package.spend_trackers`

Required:

- `alias` (String) Human-readable identifier, unique per contract.
- `applicable_spend_specifiers` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--package--spend_trackers--applicable_spend_specifiers))
- `credit_type_id` (String)
- `reset_frequency` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--package--spend_trackers--applicable_spend_specifiers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `package.spend_trackers.applicable_spend_specifiers`

Required:

- `sources` (List of String)
- `spend_type` (String)

Optional:

- `discounted` (String) Filter by whether the spend was discounted. Defaults to ANY if omitted.



<a id="nestedatt--package--subscriptions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `package.subscriptions`

Required:

- `collection_schedule` (String)
- `proration` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--package--subscriptions--proration))
- `subscription_rate` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--package--subscriptions--subscription_rate))

Optional:

- `billing_cycle_config` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--package--subscriptions--billing_cycle_config))
- `custom_fields` (Map of String)
- `description` (String)
- `duration` (Attributes) Lifetime of the subscription from its start. If not provided, subscription inherits contract end date. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--package--subscriptions--duration))
- `initial_quantity` (Number) The initial quantity for the subscription. It must be non-negative value. Required if quantity_management_mode is QUANTITY_ONLY.
- `name` (String)
- `payment_gate_config` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--package--subscriptions--payment_gate_config))
- `quantity_management_mode` (String) Determines how the subscription's quantity is controlled. Defaults to QUANTITY_ONLY. **QUANTITY_ONLY**: The subscription quantity is specified directly on the subscription. `initial_quantity` must be provided with this option. Compatible with recurring commits/credits that use POOLED allocation. **SEAT_BASED**: Use when you want to pass specific seat identifiers (e.g. add user_123) to increment and decrement a subscription quantity, rather than directly providing the quantity. You must use a **SEAT_BASED** subscription to use a linked recurring credit with an allocation per seat. `seat_config` must be provided with this option.
- `seat_config` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--package--subscriptions--seat_config))
- `starting_at_offset` (Attributes) Relative date from contract start date corresponding to the inclusive start time for the subscription. If not provided, defaults to contract start date (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--package--subscriptions--starting_at_offset))
- `subscription_alias` (String) Optional human-readable, per-package-unique alias for this subscription template. Lets a contract customization reference the subscription by alias instead of its template id.
- `temporary_id` (String) A temporary ID used to reference the subscription in recurring commit/credit subscription configs created within the same payload.

<a id="nestedatt--package--subscriptions--proration"></a>
### Nested Schema for `package.subscriptions.proration`

Optional:

- `invoice_behavior` (String) Indicates how mid-period quantity adjustments are invoiced.
**BILL_IMMEDIATELY**: Only available when collection schedule is `ADVANCE`. The quantity increase will be billed immediately on the scheduled date.
**BILL_ON_NEXT_COLLECTION_DATE**: The quantity increase will be billed for in-arrears at the end of the period.
- `is_prorated` (Boolean) Indicates if the partial period will be prorated or charged a full amount.
- `rounding` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--package--subscriptions--proration--rounding))

<a id="nestedatt--package--subscriptions--proration--rounding"></a>
### Nested Schema for `package.subscriptions.proration.rounding`

Required:

- `decimal_places` (Number) Number of decimal places to round to. Applied directly to the stored monetary representation. Negative values round to powers of 10 (e.g., -2 rounds to nearest 100 in the stored unit. For USD, this means rounding to the nearest dollar).
- `rounding_method` (String)



<a id="nestedatt--package--subscriptions--subscription_rate"></a>
### Nested Schema for `package.subscriptions.subscription_rate`

Required:

- `billing_frequency` (String) Frequency to bill subscription with. Together with product_id, must match existing rate on the rate card.
- `product_id` (String) Must be subscription type product


<a id="nestedatt--package--subscriptions--billing_cycle_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `package.subscriptions.billing_cycle_config`

Optional:

- `invoice_placement` (String) Controls whether subscriptions consolidate onto usage invoices. Defaults to ON_USAGE_INVOICE if omitted.

### Nested Schema for `package.subscriptions.duration`

Required:

- `unit` (String)
- `value` (Number)


<a id="nestedatt--package--subscriptions--payment_gate_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `package.subscriptions.payment_gate_config`

Required:

- `payment_gate_type` (String) Gate access to the subscription based on successful collection of payment. Select STRIPE for Metronome to facilitate payment via Stripe.

Optional:

- `tax_type` (String) Stripe tax is only supported for Stripe payment gateway. Select NONE if you do not wish Metronome to calculate tax on your behalf. Leaving this field blank will default to NONE.


<a id="nestedatt--package--subscriptions--seat_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `package.subscriptions.seat_config`

Required:

- `seat_group_key` (String) The property name, sent on usage events, that identifies the seat ID associated with the usage event. For example, the property name might be seat_id or user_id. The property must be set as a group key on billable metrics and a presentation/pricing group key on contract products. This allows linked recurring credits with an allocation per seat to be consumed by only one seat's usage.

Optional:

- `initial_unassigned_seats` (Number) The initial amount of unassigned seats on this subscription.


<a id="nestedatt--package--subscriptions--starting_at_offset"></a>
### Nested Schema for `package.subscriptions.starting_at_offset`

Required:

- `unit` (String)
- `value` (Number)



<a id="nestedatt--package--usage_statement_schedule"></a>
### Nested Schema for `package.usage_statement_schedule`

Required:

- `frequency` (String)

Optional:

- `day` (String) If not provided, defaults to the first day of the month.
- `invoice_generation_starting_at_offset` (Attributes) The offset at which Metronome should start generating usage invoices, relative to the contract start date.  If unspecified, contract start date will be used. This is useful to set if you want to import historical invoices via our 'Create Historical Invoices' API rather than having Metronome automatically generate them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--package--usage_statement_schedule--invoice_generation_starting_at_offset))

- `value` (Number)




<a id="nestedatt--recurring_commit"></a>
### Nested Schema for `recurring_commit`

Required:

- `applicable_product_ids` (List of String)
- `credit_type_id` (String)
- `fixed_product_id` (String)
- `grant_duration_periods` (Number) Number of monthly periods before each grant expires.
- `monthly_grant_cents` (Number)
- `monthly_price_cents` (Number)
- `name` (String)
- `priority` (Number) Use 10 so monthly grants spend before runtime top-ups at 100.
- `rollover_fraction` (Number) Fraction of unused grant that rolls over on contract transition, from 0 to 1.
